description: Full-service general contractor handling framing, additions, remodels, decks, and foundation repair for homeowners across the Ridgeview metro area. Family-run, licensed and insured, known for finishing on the timeline we quote.

reviews.author: Maria D.
reviews.text: Ironclad reframed our sagging back porch and added a full second-story addition. Crew showed up on time every single day and the final walkthrough had zero surprises.

reviews.author: Tom H.
reviews.text: Got three quotes for a deck rebuild. Ironclad wasn't the cheapest but they were the only ones who explained exactly what the old framing problem was instead of just quoting a number.

reviews.author: Priya S.
reviews.text: Foundation repair took a week longer than the original estimate because of a permit delay, but they communicated it clearly and the work itself is solid. Would hire again.

_brand_source_note: Real, live trades site reused from the Thread 1 validation spike (spikes/brand-extract/out/09-grace-family-roofing.json) so extraction has something real to chew on. This is a different real business (Grace Family Roofing) than the fake client above (Ironclad Construction Co.) - the identity mismatch this creates (extracted logo says 'GFR', not 'Ironclad') is deliberate and flagged in the breakage report, not hidden.
